_about: Validation suite config. Every value here is environment-specific -- do not commit a filled-in copy with secrets or machine paths you do not want shared. Env vars of the same name in UPPER_SNAKE override the values below.

cameo._host_workspace: REQUIRED. The path prefix the HOST running Cameo uses for this workspace. The container sees /workspace; Cameo does not. There is NO safe default: this repo's own tool descriptions disagree with each other about it (scripts/admin_bridge.groovy says /home/mac/opencode/workspace, scripts/tool_contract_resources.groovy says /home/mac/oc3/workspace, and showcase/reverse-engineering/MCP-SURFACE-FINDINGS.md records the real root as /home/mac/projects/AI/opencode/workspace). Set CAMEO_HOST_WORKSPACE to the true value.
cameo._test_models: Test models only, keyed by task id. Values are paths AS THE HOST SEES THEM (use host_workspace). Never point a task at a real model.

models._about: Catalogue of local models under test, keyed by a short name passed to --model. Populate with the models you actually want on the scaling curve. 'provider' + 'base_url' + 'model' + 'context' + 'max_output' are written verbatim into the per-run opencode.json.
